contract: POST /api/items/:id/scan rescans one library item and answers {result:"UPDATED"|"UPTODATE"}; it is admin-only and additionally requires the update permission, answers 404 for an unknown item and 500 for a file library item, and every call rereads the item's metadata/items/<id>/metadata.json for books and podcasts.

invariants.contract: The route is admin-only and requires canUpdate: an anonymous POST answers 401, a user without update permission 403, an unknown item id 404 and a file library item 500; no rejected call rescans anything, moves the item's timestamps or rewrites its sidecar.

An item scan answers {result:"UPDATED"} when it changed the item and {result:"UPTODATE"} when the item and its sidecar are unchanged; a repeat call leaves updatedAt, lastScan and the metadata.json bytes untouched.

Every item scan rereads metadata/items/<id>/metadata.json: for a book it applies title, authors, series and chapters (chapters renumbered from 0 with start/end untouched) and creates the unknown author and series rows with their sequence; for a podcast it applies title, author, genres, tags, description, releaseDate, feedURL, imageURL, itunesPageURL, itunesId, itunesArtistId, asin, language, explicit and podcastType; in both cases the scanner rewrites the sidecar with the canonical key set of the media type (seventeen book keys, fifteen podcast keys).
